svg.data-cooling: host airflow, 500 LFM required (no onboard fans)
svg.data-timing-roles: IEEE 1588v2 T-GM, T-BC/OC (G.8275.1 telecom profile); SyncE with ESMC; PTP offload and redundancy; Assisted FTS
svg.data-clock-specs: G.8271.1, G.8272 PRTC, G.8273.2 T-BC/T-TSC, G.8273.4 APTS (via firmware upgrade), G.8262 EEC, G.8262.1 eEEC, G.8264 ESMC
svg.data-oran-sync: O-RAN LLS C1, C2, C3 synchronization topologies
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR, 25G SFP28 CR DAC, 10G SFP+ SR/LR, SFP+ Twinax (datasheet supported-accessories list)
svg.data-timing-cables: SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz
svg.data-interfaces: managed from the host DU server - ufiCardMgmt CLI over the E-810 network interface to the card's management IP; UFI PTP Timing Software
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A

Class C timing accuracy (G.8273.2), T-GM / T-BC / OC roles, SyncE and G.8275.1. The modelled body is the card enclosure behind the I/O plate; the full-height PCIe bracket and the gold edge connector extend beyond it and are mounting furniture, not drawn.","format":1,"gaps":[{"note":"EVERY POSITION ON THIS FACE IS SCALED OFF A RENDER, not read off a drawing. The scale is now anchored on the PCIe bracket's governed 120.02 and corroborated by the registry's sfp-ganged pitch, which is far better than the datasheet width it replaced - but three figures agreeing to under 2 percent is corroboration, not measurement. What a drawing would settle and this cannot - whether the connector opening is the specification's 12.06 or something larger. The render cannot show it because the cages fill the opening and their bezels cover the metal around it, which is also why the bracket is not composed here yet.","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["front"],"wanted":"a dimensioned mechanical drawing of the N3100-4C faceplate from UfiSpace, or a square-on photograph with a scale in frame","what":"no-dimensioned-drawing"},{"reason":"vendor-silent","scope":["rear"],"wanted":"Identity of the SFP-cage-like connector standing on the card's rear edge near the left corner (visible in datasheet fig-0002 and HIG fig-0003 angled renders, ~15 mm wide silver shell with a black slot face). Only symmetric content is drawn, so the left-right mirror convention could not be exposed by any feature - noted per the symmetric-face rule."},"chassis":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - 'Dimension (WxDxH) 126.35 x 181.07 x 21.95 mm', transcribed as width 126.35 / depth 181.07 / height 21.95 with the card lying flat as the vendor draws it (PCB horizontal, I/O plate at the front). The full-height PCIe bracket (right end) and the PCIe x16 gold edge connector (right side, in the PCB plane) both extend beyond these figures and are not modelled, per the body-between-the-ear-folds rule - they are how the card mounts, not what it is. Whether the vendor's 126.35 includes any bracket metal is unstated; the plate drawn in the HIG faceplate figure measures consistently with 126.35 excluding the bracket tab."},"cutouts":{"confidence":"registry","note":"registry - SMB openings at 4.83 (10-32UNF-2A), SMA at 6.35 (1/4-36UNS-2B), SFP apertures 14.5 x 10.0 (SFF-8432), all centred on the drawing-measured jack/cage centres above. LED holes 2.0 nominal at the measured lamp centres (drawn lens ~2.2 in the figure)."},"environment":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - operating 0-55 C, 5-95 percent RH; storage humidity 5-93 percent. Storage temperature DISAGREES between the two documents: the datasheet says -40 to 70 C, the HIG installation requirements say -40 to 65 C - same measure, same scope, different value. The manifest carries the datasheet figure (the spec-table source); registered in gaps as sources-disagree."},"front-layout":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing - HIG fig-0005 (straight-on faceplate render, 1471x259 px). Gate 1: the plate face measures 1172 x 200 px against the datasheet 126.35 x 21.95 mm - aspect 5.86 vs 5.76, 1.8 percent - so fractions were taken per-axis at 9.276 px/mm (x, plate left edge at px 68) and 9.112 px/mm (y, top edge at px 7). SMB jack centres at x 18.65 / 31.37, y 11.0 (visually centred, plate centre 10.97); SMA centre (119.42, 9.77); SFP28 cage block px 426-1096 giving centres x 47.62 / 65.68 / 83.74 / 101.80 on an 18.06 mm pitch, cage vertical centre y 11.85; port LEDs (green, one per port, left of each number tag) centres x 43.99 / 61.88 / 79.67 / 97.46 at y 4.17. The photo confirms every count and the left-to-right order (1PPS, 10MHz, ports 0-3, GNSS ANT). The bracket retention screw head on the plate's left end reads 6.5 mm at centre (6.41, 7.46); drawn with common/screw-head at its 3.6 mm contract size, delta recorded here."},"port-leds":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing - one green lamp per SFP28 port, above the cage's left half beside the yellow port-number tag (HIG fig-0005; photo confirms). HIG 3.1: Off = no cable/no traffic, blinking green = 25G TX/RX, blinking amber = 10G or less TX/RX. The yellow number tags (5.9 x 2.85 mm, measured from the figure) are drawn as decor with the numeral as silkscreen ink on top."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - 'Max power Consumption: 48 Watts, Typical Power Consumption: 34 Watts' under the Power Supply row; the HIG repeats the 48 W maximum. Neither document states what configuration the figures assume (optics population), so power-envelope is unstated. Power is drawn from the host PCIe slot; there is no PSU."},"rear-layout":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - no straight-on rear source. The rear is the enclosure's plain end with the PCB edge below it; drawn as the cover band over a PCB strip, sizes from the chassis contract. Angled renders (datasheet fig-0002, HIG fig-0003) show an unidentified SFP-cage-like connector standing on the rear edge near the left corner - no document names it, so it is NOT drawn; registered as a gap per the unidentified-feature precedent (gl-8xep right-side boss)."},"side-layout":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - both sides are the enclosure cover over the PCB edge; only the angled renders show them, so positions are estimates. LEFT side (x=0 = REAR per house convention) carries a micro-USB receptacle on the PCB near the front (datasheet fig-0002 bottom-left; centre estimated 13 mm behind the faceplate at PCB level) - the part is unmistakably a micro-USB, its function is stated nowhere (gap). RIGHT side (x=0 = FRONT) is the PCIe edge: the gold x16 edge connector extends beyond this face in the PCB plane and is not drawn; the face shows the cover over the PCB strip."},"silkscreen":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing - 1PPS, 10MHZ (spelled with a capital Z as printed) and GNSS ANT in dark ink below their jacks, port numerals 0-3 in black on the yellow tags; transcribed from fig-0005 and confirmed against the photo. The Sync LED is unlabelled on the hardware."},"silkscreen-recentred-after-the-rescale":{"note":"A LEGEND'S POSITION IS NOT A POINT THAT SCALES WITH ITS PART. Cutout and component sizes are governed - 4.83 for an SMB hole, 14.5 for an SFP aperture - so they did not move, but a centre is `at` plus half a size and only `at` changed. Converting the labels by the same transform as the parts left seven of them up to 1.54 mm off centre, which L61 reported. They are recentred on their PLACEMENTS, which is what L61 measures: the cutout centre differs wherever the component is wider than its hole, as the SMA jack's 9.5 is wider than its 6.35 opening."},"sources":{"note":"vendor datasheet (dimensions row, interfaces, power, environment, compliance), installation guide v1.1 17-Jul-2023 (n3100-4c-hig - faceplate render fig-0005 with the Sync LED callout, LED behaviour tables, PCIe slot requirements, installation CAD in fig-0004), vendor render photo (photos/n3100-4c-1-view.jpg, single angled card shot - counts and colour only), angled datasheet render (datasheet fig-0002 - left-edge micro-USB, rear-edge connector)."},"sync-led":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing - the HIG fig-0005 callout leader points at a small dark rectangular lamp (px 289-310 x 168-178, ~2.3 x 1.1 mm) between the 1PPS and 10MHZ legends, centre (24.96, 18.22); the HIG names it the Sync LED. It carries NO printed legend on the plate - the name exists only in the guide. Drawn with common/led-dot (2.0 round), the closest library part; the rectangular 2.3 x 1.1 lens and the delta are recorded here. States from the HIG section 3.1 table."},"the-x-scale-was-anchored-on-the-wrong-edge":{"note":"CORRECTED. The x fractions above were taken at 9.276 px/mm by reading the datasheet's 126.35 as the width of the PLATE. It is not. 126.35 is the whole card; the plate is the standard full-height PCIe bracket at 120.02, and the remaining 6.33 is the PCB and its components standing proud of the metal at the left end - which the render shows directly, their ink breaking below the plate's own lower edge. A bracket cannot be 6.33 over the specification and still enter a slot. Re-anchored on the card's full ink extent, px 7 to 1465, the scale is 11.547 px/mm and three governed figures land that had not before: the bracket measures 120.98 against PCIe CEM 5.0 figure 11-5's 120.02 (0.8 percent), the SFP28 pitch 14.30 against the registry's sfp-ganged share of 14.25 (0.4 percent), and the four-cage block 58.02 against 4 x 14.25 (1.8 percent). At the old scale the pitch read 18.06, which cannot be right for cages that share walls - the figure shows one unbroken dark run across all four - and the SMA and SMB nuts read 12.90 and 10.06 against threads the datasheet itself names as 1/4-36UNS and 10-32UNF. THE PIXEL READINGS WERE NEVER WRONG, only the anchor. Every feature listed above reproduces to within one pixel under the stated mapping, so each x was converted rather than re-measured. THE Y SCALE STANDS: the plate spans 199 px over the card's 21.95 height, which is 9.066 px/mm against the 9.112 recorded - 0.5 percent, inside the reading error - because the height was anchored on a dimension that IS the face. Only x was wrong."},"top-layout":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - the top is the sheet-metal cover; angled renders show it plain with the green PCB margin visible along the right (PCIe) edge. Axis convention: y=0 is the REAR, per the house top-view precedent. Cover screw positions are not resolvable from the angled renders and are not drawn."},"vents":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing - square perforations around the SMB pair, ~2.5 mm squares on a 4.15 mm pitch: a six-square top row from x 12.72 (the row's right end is washed out by glare in the render; six is what both the render and the photo resolve), a three-square column at x 11.10 left of the 1PPS jack, and a two-square column at x 23.72 between the jacks. Sizes and pitch measured from fig-0005; the photo confirms the arrangement."},"weight":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet - net weight 0.44 kg / 0.97
